name: scg-library
description: Secure, read-only access to the SCG Library from Codex.

interface.longDescription: Authenticates each user through Auth0, auto-approves exact Cisco-domain identities, requires administrator approval for other verified domains, honors revocation, and turns natural-language questions into read-only structured queries and summaries across the SCG business-data library.
defaultPrompt: Using SCG Library, list the available data collections.
Using SCG Library, tell me everything we know about a customer.
Using SCG Library, count and summarize records matching my question.
